prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a card layout featuring structured pet identity fields and official confirmation cards.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "card"}}
1: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Split Screen Layout: Re-layout the story screen using a split view layout combining story visuals on one side with onboarding narrative copy on the other.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split"}}
2: [home, new_screen] New Desktop Companion Setup Screen: Insert a new screen before the waiting stage to introduce desktop overlay permissions and screen placement options.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_desktop_setup", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_setup": {"headline": "Desktop Setup & Permissions", "body": "Configure your screen overlay preferences so your new pet can freely roam on your desktop.", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [sign_in, copy] Persistent Account Sync Sign In Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to assure users that signing in permanently saves and syncs their desktop pet to their account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Pet", "body": "Your pet customization and progress are automatically saved to your cloud account so you never lose them."}}
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro completion screen into a split layout clearly separating desktop controls from interaction guides.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split"}}
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Realtime Progress Timer: Add an explicit time estimate switch and visual progress timer component on the pet generation waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Resolution Hint: Add a photo quality guidance hint explaining optimal lighting and framing on the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload well-lit, front-facing photos with clear background contrast."}}
7: [sign_in, new_flow] Quick Choice Cards Sign In Options: Replace standard sign in option elements with formatted quick choice cards for sign in methods.
   config: {"sign_in": {"replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Quick Login Method", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}}
8: [sign_in, reorder] Adoption Certificate Before Sign In Order: Move sign_in to occur immediately after completing the adoption certificate step rather than before pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
9: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Journey Expectations Copy: Update choose path body copy to outline the quick adoption steps immediately following path selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"body": "Select your companion path to begin. You can choose a pre-made pet or create a unique custom companion in just a few steps."}}
